ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface area, with low-intensity black pixels concentrated along the trailing edges and central peduncle insertion point.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous zone occupying the central 2D space. Low-intensity (black) pixels define a continuous serrated perimeter along the trailing edge. A dense, vertically-oriented dark cluster is located at the ventral center-base. Sparse low-intensity focal spots (mottling) are distributed across the mid-lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 55 degrees; vertex is sharply defined at the central longitudinal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present across the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged peaks and irregular valleys alternate along the linear path, with maximum amplitude peaks located toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves originating from the peduncle and tapering toward sharp, slightly upturned distal endpoints.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular low-intensity pixel clusters (approx. 5-12 pixels in diameter) visible in the mid-interior of both the left and right lobes, consistent with localized scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned dark linear disruptions observed on the left lobe, oriented roughly horizontal relative to the fluke's leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregular topography and high-contrast pixel noise on the right distal tip, indicating significant trauma or calcified barnacle colonization. Significant notch-like tissue irregularities along the left lobe trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense, asymmetrical vertical dark pigmentation streak at the median fluke base, extending into the ventral white field.
